identity.description: Clay (clay.com) is a go-to-market data enrichment and prospecting platform, with a developer site at developers.clay.com and a Clay Public API.
identity.identity_notes: Developer docs at developers.clay.com describe the Clay Public API, CLI and MCP for Clay workspaces; the pricing page at clay.com/pricing covers the same product. The 'clay.com' hint matches. The product description is inferred from these pages, not from a single explicit product-definition quote.

auth.token_refresh: Not applicable: static API key. No rotation mechanism described.
auth.scopes_notes: API keys are tied to a Clay user and workspace access. No scope model described in the fetched pages.

access.production_restrictions: No app review described for the API key path. Some API resources are labeled Enterprise and Enterprise pricing is custom, so sales contact may be needed for those features; sources conflict on whether the general Clay API is Enterprise-only or Growth-and-above.

resources: Routines (execute routines against items, batch runs)
Tables (structured query across tables, Enterprise label)
read_ops: Fetch progress and results for a routine run
Fetch progress and results for a batch run
Run the query-mode iterator and return the next page of results
Get the Clay search query reference
Run a structured query across one or more tables
write_ops: Start an async routine run-batch over an uploaded JSONL file
Issue a presigned PUT URL for uploading a batch input JSONL
Create a search from a Clay search query
api.rate_limits: A rate-limits guide exists (developers.clay.com/public-api/rate-limits.md) and covers 429 handling, but specific limit values were not retrieved.
api.limitations: No public company/contact/record CRUD endpoints appear in the API reference; the API centers on running routines (enrichment workflows), search, and table queries. Workflows are labeled Alpha and workflow-run search is beta. Filters-mode search endpoints are deprecated. No SDK mentioned.
